name: wrkbench
description: Configurable workshop inventory and maintenance manager

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w protocol && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w bridge
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client && npm test -w bridge
